audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[].side reads 'Skill' on every row while content.win[] and the packet levelChart give Tahm Kench level 1, even level 2, Rell levels 3 through first item, and Tahm Kench again at 2+ items.
audit.why: Rell has no ranged poke pre-6 so level 1 is a free walk-up; her point-blank W Ferromancy: Crash Down into E Full Tilt stun chain is hard to dodge once both are online (level 3+); Magnet Storm (R) drags the whole backline together, more than a single Devour can answer; but at 2+ items Tahm Kench's per-fight peel out-values her single committed engage.
audit.corrected: phases[0,2,3,4,5,6].side moved to match win[] and the packet chart; matching why text rewritten. phases[1] already matches win[1]='Skill' and is left alone.

audit.why: Level 6 is correctly the sharpest window for Rell (Magnet Storm) and 2+ items is where Tahm Kench's tank body swings the grouped fight back, matching the ratings already on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real number, and neither missingInteractions item (Q/W shields absorbing burst; Full Tilt's auto-reset as the real combo tell) reaches the text.
audit.why: Shattering Strike (Q) breaks shields but Crash Down (W, 10s cooldown) grants Rell her own large shield on dismount, so baiting that shield out first changes all-in math; Full Tilt (E) is an auto-attack reset — the attack wind-up, not the E cast, is the cue to disengage.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with Crash Down's 10s cooldown and the shield-bait note; dosFull[2] rewritten to flag the Full Tilt auto-reset tell.
